items.title: New Sorento Midsize SUV Sells 1,739 Units in First Month, Kia India Sales Grow 29% in H1 FY2027
items.summary: The new Kia Sorento midsize SUV, launched on September 4, has sold 1,739 units in its first full month of wholesales (factory dispatches) in the domestic market. Kia India’s new ICE-powered flagship SUV, which was the fifth highest-selling model for the company last month, contributed 5% to Kia India’s record monthly sales in September.

items.title: Motorcycle OEMs clock second-highest H1 sales of 6.92 million, Hero and Honda up 12%, Bajaj down 7%
items.summary: The motorcycle segment, the largest two-wheeler sub-segment in India, has registered its second highest first-half wholesales in April-September 2026. The 6.92 million units, up 10% YoY (H1 FY2026: 6.27 million units) are now the next best after the record 7.37 million motorcycles sold in H1 FY2019.

items.title: Axor Introduces Agera Full-Face Helmet
items.summary: Axor, owned by Vega Auto, has launched a new full-face motorcycle helmet named Agera. The helmet is designed with an integrated rear spoiler that functions as an exhaust vent to assist airflow and reduce drag.

items.title: Scooter sales jump 29% to 4.86 million units in H1 FY2027, EV share grows to 20%
items.summary: The high-performing scooter industry has clocked two new milestones in the closing month of first-half FY2027. While the 995,576 units sold in September 2026 were the highest monthly wholesales yet for this two-wheeler category, cumulative six-month sales (April-September 2026) at 48,65,192 units or 4.86 million scooters sets a new high for the first-half of a fiscal year.

items.title: Q2 surge powers electric car, SUV sales past 192,000 units in first-half FY2027
items.summary: India’s electric vehicle growth story is really charged up this year. After the first six months of FY2027, total retail sales of 18,10,163 million EVs across the e-2W, e-3W, e-passenger and e-commercial vehicle segments have risen 60% YoY (H1 FY2025: 11,34,054 units) and are already 71% of FY2026’s record 2.54 million EVs.

items.title: Electric CV Sales Jump 155% to 23,540 Units, Tata Motors Tops but Euler Motors Shines
items.summary: In sync with the strong growth of the EV industry in India , the electric commercial vehicle (e-CV) segment is also hitting new highs this year. Not only did it register highest monthly sales in August (4,746 units, up 191% YoY) but its cumulative January-August retail sales of 23,540 units are already 6,895 units more than entire CY2025 sales (16,695 units).

items.title: Tractor Industry Faces H2 Reality Check as Wholesale Dispatches Fall 18%
items.summary: Tractor makers are entering the festive season after a monsoon that ended about 13 percent below normal, according to India Meteorological Department (IMD) data. Concerns about a strong El Niño raise the risk of further pressure on rural demand.

items.title: Vinfast India sells 14,600 EVs since market entry 14 months ago
items.summary: Vinfast Auto India, the local arm of the Vietnamese electric vehicle major VinFast, has delivered 14,637 zero-emission passenger vehicles to customers since its market launch on September 6, 2025 through to October 14, 2026. items.title: BKT, Pirelli Plan 50:50 Joint Venture For Passenger Car Tyres In India
items.summary: Balkrishna Industries (BKT) and Pirelli Tyre have signed agreements to establish a 50:50 joint venture (JV) for manufacturing passenger car radial (PCR) tyres in India. Under the proposed arrangement, the two companies will manufacture tyres under their respective brands, with a new manufacturing plant planned in India.

items.summary: Passenger vehicle market leader Maruti Suzuki India has crossed the 1-million wholesales mark for the first time in the first-half of a fiscal in April-September 2026. items.title: Schaeffler India CEO Harsha Kadam Taken Into Police Custody Over Fatal June Factory Accident
items.summary: Schaeffler India Limited Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer Harsha Gopal Kadam was taken into police custody, in connection with an investigation into a fatal industrial accident at the company's Talegaon manufacturing facility, according to a regulatory disclosure filed Tuesday. items.title: Subros Opens Advanced Thermal R&D Innovation Center in Noida
items.summary: Subros Limited announced that it has established a new R&D facility in Noida, Sector 136, according to a stock exchange notification filed on Thursday. Named the Subros Advanced Technologies and Innovation Centre (SATIC), the facility functions as an extension of the company's existing research and development operations.
